messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: For how long must the manufacturer keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity?

Facts:
[0] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retainedAvailableFor — at least 10 years after the product has been placed on the market (at least 10 years after the product has been placed on the market) [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[1] Manufacturers — keepAtDisposal — technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity for market surveillance authorities (technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity for market surveillance authorities) [condition: for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 10(3)]
[2] Digital EU declarations of conformity — shall be made accessible online — for at least 10 years after placing on the market or putting into service of the machinery or related product (for at least 10 years after placing on the market or putting into service of the machinery or related product) [condition: applies in any event, as a minimum period] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[3] Manufacturers of partly completed machinery — keepAtDisposal — technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation (technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation) [condition: for at least 10 years after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market; made available to market surveillance authorities] [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[4] Digital EU declarations of conformity — shall be made accessible online — for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product (for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[5] Importers — keepDeclarationCopy — copy of the EU declaration of conformity, kept at the disposal of market surveillance authorities (copy of the EU declaration of conformity, kept at the disposal of market surveillance authorities) [condition: for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 13(8)]
[6] Manufacturer — keeps — a copy of the certificate, its annexes and additions, with the technical documentation at the disposal of national authorities (a copy of the certificate, its annexes and additions, with the technical documentation at the disposal of national authorities) [condition: for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[7] manufacturer of machinery or authorised representative — shallKeepOriginal — EC declaration of conformity for at least 10 years (EC declaration of conformity for at least 10 years) [condition: from the last date of manufacture of the machinery] [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[8] relevant technical documentation for partly completed machinery — must be available for — at least 10 years following the date of manufacture, or of the last unit produced in series manufacture (at least 10 years following the date of manufacture, or of the last unit produced in series manufacture) [DIR, Annex VII]
[9] mandate — shall allow — authorised representative to keep technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of national market surveillance authorities (authorised representative to keep technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of national market surveillance authorities) [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[10] A copy of the EU declaration of conformity — shallBeMadeAvailableTo — relevant authorities (relevant authorities) [condition: upon request] [REG, Annex VIII, 3]
[11] manufacturers — mustDrawUpDeclarationOfConformity — EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 (EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21) [condition: compliance with the essential health and safety requirements in Annex III has been demonstrated by the conformity assessment procedure] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[12] Importers — keepCopyOfDeclaration — copy of the EU declaration of incorporation, kept at the disposal of market surveillance authorities (copy of the EU declaration of incorporation, kept at the disposal of market surveillance authorities) [condition: for at least 10 years after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 14(7)]
[13] manufacturer and notified body — retainCopyOfCertificateAndFile — certificate, technical file and relevant documents (certificate, technical file and relevant documents) [condition: for 15 years from the date of issue of the certificate] [DIR, Annex IX]
[14] technical file — must include — a copy of the EC declaration of conformity (a copy of the EC declaration of conformity) [DIR, Annex VII]
[15] Manufacturers — shall ensure — machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A (machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A) [condition: alternatively, see the internet-address option] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[16] Manufacturers — shall provide — internet address or machine-readable code where the EU declaration of conformity can be accessed, in the instructions for use (internet address or machine-readable code where the EU declaration of conformity can be accessed, in the instructions for use) [condition: as an alternative to accompanying the declaration] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[17] manufacturers — mustDrawUpTechnicalDocumentation — technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A (technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A) [condition: before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[18] Tracing log of data and safety software versions uploaded after placing on market — is enabled for — five years after such upload (five years after such upload) [condition: exclusively to demonstrate conformity, further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[19] technical file — must be capable of being assembled and made available by — the person designated in the EC declaration of conformity (the person designated in the EC declaration of conformity) [condition: within a period of time commensurate with its complexity] [DIR, Annex VII]
[20] copy of the EU declaration of conformity — mustBeMadeAvailableTo — relevant authorities (relevant authorities) [condition: upon request] [REG, Annex VI, 4]
[21] instructions for use — mustInclude — EU declaration of conformity, or internet address or machine readable code (EU declaration of conformity, or internet address or machine readable code) [condition: where the EU declaration of conformity can be accessed, in accordance with Article 10(8)] [REG, Annex III, 1.7.4.2]
[22] Manufacturers — provideToAuthority — all information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity with the Regulation (all information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity with the Regulation) [condition: further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Art. 11(10)]
[23] Recorded data on safety-related decision-making — is retained for — one year after its collection (one year after its collection) [condition: exclusively to demonstrate conformity, further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[24] EU declaration of conformity (REG Annex V, Part A) — mustState — name and address of the manufacturer (name and address of the manufacturer) [REG, Annex V, Part A, point 2]
[25] Importers — ensure — manufacturer has drawn up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A (manufacturer has drawn up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A) [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[26] Manufacturers — shallEnsure — partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B (partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B) [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[27] EC declaration of conformity — mustContain — place and date of the declaration (place and date of the declaration) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[28] Manufacturer — shallMakeAccessibleOnline — instructions for use (instructions for use) [condition: during expected lifetime and for at least 10 years after placing on market] [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[29] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — shall draw up — EU declaration of incorporation in accordance with Article 22 (EU declaration of incorporation in accordance with Article 22) [condition: compliance with the relevant essential health and safety requirements in Annex III has been demonstrated in the technical documentation in Annex IV, Part B] [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[30] importers — mustEnsureBeforeMarketing — manufacturer has drawn up technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B (manufacturer has drawn up technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[31] Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — shall ensure that technical documentation is prepared — relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B (relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B) [condition: before placing the machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[32] Importers — ensureDocumentationAvailable — technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B, made available to market surveillance authorities (technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B, made available to market surveillance authorities) [condition: upon request] [REG, Art. 14(7)]
[33] EU declaration of conformity (REG Annex V, Part A) — mustState — name and address of the authorised representative (name and address of the authorised representative) [condition: where the manufacturer has one] [REG, Annex V, Part A, point 2]
[34] Importers — ensureTechnicalDocumentation — technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A, can be made available to market surveillance authorities (technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A, can be made available to market surveillance authorities) [condition: upon request] [REG, Art. 13(8)]
[35] EU declaration of conformity, Annex V Part A — requiresIssuePlaceAndDate — place and date of issue must be stated (place and date of issue must be stated) [REG, Annex V, Part A, point 10]
[36] Technical documentation for partly completed machinery — shallSpecify — the means used by the manufacturer to ensure conformity with the relevant essential health and safety requirements in Annex III (the means used by the manufacturer to ensure conformity with the relevant essential health and safety requirements in Annex III) [REG, Annex IV, Part B]
[37] Distributors — shall provide — all information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity with the Regulation, in paper or digital format (all information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity with the Regulation, in paper or digital format) [condition: further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Art. 15(6)]
[38] Importers — mustProvideToAuthority — all information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity of the machinery or related products with this Regulation (all information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity of the machinery or related products with this Regulation) [condition: upon a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Art. 13(9)]
[39] Risultati dei controlli di cui al comma 8 — devono essere — conservati (conservati) [condition: almeno quelli relativi agli ultimi tre anni] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 9]
[40] Manufacturer's renewal application — must be submitted — at the earliest 12 months and at the latest 6 months prior to the expiry date of the EU type-examination certificate (at the earliest 12 months and at the latest 6 months prior to the expiry date of the EU type-examination certificate) [condition: the review leads to renewal only when this timing is met] [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[41] single EU declaration of conformity — shall contain — publication references of the Union legal acts concerned (publication references of the Union legal acts concerned) [condition: where multiple Union legal acts apply] [REG, Art. 21(3)]
[42] the manufacturer — assumesResponsibilityFor — compliance of the partly completed machinery with the requirements laid down in this Regulation (compliance of the partly completed machinery with the requirements laid down in this Regulation) [condition: by drawing up the EU declaration of incorporation] [REG, Art. 22(4)]
[43] Information and documentation — purpose — demonstrating conformity of machinery or related products with this Regulation (demonstrating conformity of machinery or related products with this Regulation) [REG, Art. 10(10)]
[44] Manufacturers — shall take account of — changes in the production process, in the design or characteristics of the machinery, and in the harmonised standards, other technical specifications, or common specifications used to declare conformity (changes in the production process, in the design or characteristics of the machinery, and in the harmonised standards, other technical specifications, or common specifications used to declare conformity) [condition: by reference to which the conformity of the machinery is declared] [REG, Art. 10(4)]
[45] Manufacturers — shall give details to competent national authorities — details of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken (details of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken) [condition: when informing authorities of a risk under Article 10(9)] [REG, Art. 10(9)]
[46] EU declaration of incorporation — must include references to — other technical specifications relied on for declared conformity (other technical specifications relied on for declared conformity) [condition: condition: in relation to which conformity is declared] [REG, Annex V, Part B, point 6]
[47] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — shall draw up — technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B (technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[48] EU declaration of conformity — isTranslatedInto — language or languages required by the Member State (language or languages required by the Member State) [condition: where the machinery or related product is placed on the market, made available on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 21(2)]
[49] declaration of conformity — issuedUnderSoleResponsibilityOf — the manufacturer (the manufacturer) [REG, Annex V, Part A, point 4]
[50] Notified body — keeps — a copy of the certificate, its annexes and additions, and the technical file for five years (a copy of the certificate, its annexes and additions, and the technical file for five years) [condition: after the expiry of the validity of that certificate] [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[51] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — shallKeepOriginal — declaration of incorporation for at least 10 years (declaration of incorporation for at least 10 years) [condition: from the last date of manufacture of the partly completed machinery] [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[52] mandate — shall allow — providing competent national authority with information and documentation demonstrating conformity (providing competent national authority with information and documentation demonstrating conformity) [condition: further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[53] mandate — shall allow — cooperation with competent national authorities on actions to eliminate risks (cooperation with competent national authorities on actions to eliminate risks) [condition: at the request of the authorities, and for products covered by the mandate] [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[54] Organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente — espleta procedure nei confronti di — fabbricante ovvero soggetti della catena della distribuzione (fabbricante ovvero soggetti della catena della distribuzione) [condition: alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico risulta la non conformità dell'attrezzatura ad uno o più requisiti essenziali di sicurezza] [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4]
[55] chi noleggia o concede in uso l'attrezzatura — deve acquisire e conservare agli atti — una dichiarazione autocertificativa (una dichiarazione autocertificativa) [condition: per tutta la durata del noleggio o della concessione dell'attrezzatura] [DLGS72, art. 72, c. 2]
[56] datore di lavoro — segue per le frequenze dei controlli periodici — indicazioni dei fabbricanti, norme di buona tecnica o codici di buona prassi (indicazioni dei fabbricanti, norme di buona tecnica o codici di buona prassi) [condition: in assenza di indicazioni dei fabbricanti e norme] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[57] Technical documentation — specifiesMeans — the means used by the manufacturer to ensure conformity with the applicable essential health and safety requirements in Annex III (the means used by the manufacturer to ensure conformity with the applicable essential health and safety requirements in Annex III) [REG, Annex IV, Part A]
[58] Declaration of incorporation — mustContain — name and address of the person authorised to compile the relevant technical documentation, who must be established in the Community (name and address of the person authorised to compile the relevant technical documentation, who must be established in the Community) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[59] Relevant technical documentation — has been compiled in accordance with — Part B of Annex VII of the Machinery Directive (Part B of Annex VII of the Machinery Directive) [ur5e-manual, p. 220]
[60] Manufacturer — compiledTechnicalDocumentationPerPartB — Part B of Annex VII of the Machinery Directive (Part B of Annex VII of the Machinery Directive) [ur10e-manual, p. 227]
[61] Global Compliance Document — isAvailableFor — download on the manufacturer's website (download on the manufacturer's website) [ur10e-manual, p. 229]
[62] Conformity declarations and certificates — downloadableFrom — "Downloads" > "Certificates" ("Downloads" > "Certificates") [condition: on the product page found by part number] [nanoscan3-manual, p. 149]
[63] IGEA S.p.A. — mette a disposizione del verificatore — tutta la documentazione necessaria (tutta la documentazione necessaria) [igea-equipment, p. 4]
[64] Durata del servizio — è — anni 3 (2019, 2020, 2021) (anni 3 (2019, 2020, 2021)) [igea-equipment, p. 4]
[65] verifiche periodiche — must follow — D.lgs. 81/08 and D.M. 11 aprile 2011 procedures in All. VII (D.lgs. 81/08 and D.M. 11 aprile 2011 procedures in All. VII) [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[66] verifica periodica — deve seguire — art.71 c.11 D.Lgs. 81/08 come modificato dalla Legge 98/2013, Allegato VII del D.Lgs. 81/08 e D.M. 11 aprile 2011 (art.71 c.11 D.Lgs. 81/08 come modificato dalla Legge 98/2013, Allegato VII del D.Lgs. 81/08 e D.M. 11 aprile 2011) [igea-equipment, p. 3]

response.text: {"reasoning": "Fact [1] directly states that manufacturers must keep the technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service (REG Art. 10(3)). Fact [0] gives the same at-least-10-years period, counted from placing on the market, though it is framed under Art. 12(2) and does not name the manufacturer. Both agree on 10 years, so the answer is P10Y. Other 10-year facts concern importers, partly completed machinery, or the EC/Directive regime, so they are not used.", "kind": "duration", "value": "P10Y", "text": "The manufacturer must keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service (Regulation, Art. 10(3)).", "used": [0, 1]}
